tail:
✓ automatic base follows checkout at creation, explicit base stays fixed, and later branch changes preserve the frozen start
✓ commits API and both verification protocols use the frozen start after checkout; legacy and unknown baselines stay honest
✓ deleted target can be reset and accepted without changing source/start; stale, busy, pending, archived and merged changes rejected
✓ detached derived task blocks safely, target selection restores dependency checks and parent cleanup
✓ explicit nonexistent merge target is rejected as actionable JSON before creating a task
✓ unreadable pinned start permits reuse/restore but cannot rebuild from a different commit
✓ empty repository creates lazily and starts after the initial commit
✓ detached HEAD pins its commit, can start, and resolves its target at acceptance
✓ stale base keeps the existing runtime fallback and can be accepted
✓ repoPath stored with ~ resolves for the branch plan and merges on acceptance
✓ serial isolated workers branch at their own start and preserve that workspace on retry
